basic_details.short_information: The College of Horticulture, Durgapura, Jaipur, of S.K.N. Agriculture University, Jobner, will hold a walk-in interview on 29 October 2026 at 10.30 AM at the Dean Office, COH, Durgapura. The college is engaging guest faculty (outsource faculty or retired teachers) to teach two courses to B.Sc. (Hons.) Horti. students: Physical Education, first Aid, Yoga Practice and Meditation (PEYP-211) and Introductory Mathematics (MATHS-111). The engagement is purely on contract. The pay is Rs. 600/- per class for theory classes and Rs. 800 per class for practical classes, counted per course per batch.

content_sections.heading: About SKNAU
content_sections.text: The College of Horticulture, Durgapura, Jaipur, is a college of S.K.N. Agriculture University (SKNAU), Jobner. It runs the B.Sc. (Hons.) Horti. programme, and the guest faculty engaged through this notice will teach courses in that programme. The college's Dean is Prof. L. N. Bairwa, Dean & FC (Hort.).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The college is engaging guest faculty for teaching. The notice counts the openings as courses: one course for each subject. The minimum qualification for both courses is a PG Degree in concerned subject . The college will give preference for outsource faculty to NET/Ph.D. Degree Holders. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for each course. Candidates should not be more than 65 years old. The notice does not give an "as on" date for working out age. The same emoluments apply to both courses: Guest/outsource faculty will be engaged purely on contract for one semester only (Sem-I, Session 2026-27). Selected candidates have no right to claim a regular appointment on any post if the university advertises one. If an engaged candidate's performance is found unsatisfactory, the engagement contract can be withdrawn without prior notice. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? faq.question: Q1. When is the SKNAU guest faculty walk-in interview in 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 29 October 2026 at 10.30 AM at the Dean Office, COH, Durgapura. Bio-data must also be submitted on 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SKNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one course of Physical Education, first Aid, Yoga Practice and Meditation (PEYP-211) and one course of Introductory Mathematics (MATHS-111).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for the SKNAU guest faculty posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is a PG Degree in concerned subject. Preference for outsource faculty will be given to NET/Ph.D. Degree Holders.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SKNAU guest faculty?
faq.answer: Candidates should not be more than 65 years old.

faq.question: Q5. How much do SKNAU guest faculty get paid?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 600/- per class per course per batch for theory classes and Rs. 800 per class for practical classes. The maximum payment for one credit hour is Rs. 9000 for theory and Rs. 12000/- for practical classes.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your bio-data, all original documents and one set of self-attested documents supporting your claim to age, qualification, experience, etc. Retired persons must also submit their PPO.

faq.question: Q7. Is the SKNAU guest faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on contract for one semester only (Sem-I, Session 2026-27). Selected candidates have no right to claim a regular appointment, and the contract can be withdrawn without prior notice if performance is found unsatisfactory.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired teachers attend the SKNAU walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice invites guest faculty (outsource faculty or retired teachers). Retired persons are required to submit their PPO.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.
